_readme: Machine-readable feeds for the weekly Global Culture Calendar sync (netlify/functions/culture-events-sync.mts). A feed is only read when "enabled": true AND it passes validation: https, host in allowedHosts, a name, and verifiedOn (the date a person confirmed the URL serves a current official calendar). No feed has been enabled: on 2026-10-04 probes of the official sites of Formula 1, Art Basel, the Venice Biennale, Salone del Mobile, Edinburgh Fringe and Wimbledon found no official ICS/JSON calendar endpoints (404/410), so none is claimed. Coverage therefore comes from the curated watchlist (netlify/config/culture-watchlist.json) plus staff verification. Add a feed only after verifying its URL; see docs/culture-calendar.md for the fields.
